acceptance: Do not execute any install, bootstrap, start or loopback probe until the owner explicitly approves the exact pinned source and supplies the special password; preflight PASS is not install authorization.
Use only the accepted installer/controller at the accepted source SHA, verify checksums before execution, and never reuse the stopped Rooms TEST database or the old rooms-only preflight.
Install fresh candidate paths/account/unit only; existing host services that remain enabled (mcp-server if kept, mcp-test, caddy, x-ui and other host services) must remain untouched.
Collect sanitized install/bootstrap/loopback evidence; STOP permanently on drift, occupied port, unexpected identity/path or capacity failure; no automatic retry.
Do not publish, enable HTTPS, issue real credentials or merge/release without further separate owner approvals.
